title: Comparing Logarithmic and Polynomial Growth
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether f(x) = (ln x)^5 or g(x) = x^(0.1) grows faster as x -> oo.
finalAnswer: g(x) = x^{0.1} \text{ grows faster than } f(x) = (\ln x)^5

steps.title: Set Up Limit Quotient
steps.explanation: Evaluate the ratio of the two functions as x approaches infinity.

steps.title: Apply Repeated L'Hopital or Power Substitution
steps.explanation: Any positive power of x eventually dominates any power of ln(x).

steps.title: Conclude Dominance
steps.explanation: The limit is 0, proving g(x) dominates.
